content: Next.js uses file-system based routing, meaning you can use folders and files to define routes. This page will guide you through how to create layouts and pages, and link between them.

content: Use the searchParams prop when you need search parameters to load data for the page (e.g. pagination, filtering from a database).Use useSearchParams when search parameters are used only on the client (e.g. filtering a list already loaded via props).As a small optimization, you can use new URLSearchParams(window.location.search) in callbacks or event handlers to read search params without triggering re-renders.
